text:
Aisha (support): multiple customers reporting p99 timeouts and elevated p95 this morning after the runtime rollout. first alerts ~07:12 UTC. tickets opened: C-512, C-513, C-517. some timeouts at 12s. can we triage? :alarm_clock:

deploy-bot: Canary rollout started: runtime v3.3.0 -> 15% traffic to canary pool

Jon (oncall): quick look at dashboard: p50 stable, p95 up from ~200ms -> ~480ms, p99 spikes >3s on eu-central. Affected models: generation with long context (>800 tokens). link: https://console.redwood.internal/dashboards/runtime/eu-central (internal)

Victor (runtime): any recent changes in kernel selection/quantization logic in v3.3.0?

Harold (benchmarks): yes — v3.3.0 enabled dynamic int8 path selection by default for eligible models. On certain sequence lengths the int8 attention kernel currently falls back to a slow reference attn due to an alignment issue with packed KV layout. Logs show `kernel=int8_attn (shape=32x1024) -> fallback=attn_ref`. Fallback is ~4x slower for long contexts.

Priya (serving): can we reproduce on a canary node? here's a quick repro curl (include debug header to collect kernel decisions):

```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "X-RDW-Debug: kernel-decisions" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-gen-large","input":"'"`python -c "print('A'*2000)"`"'"}' \
  https://inference.redwood.internal/v1/generate -w '\\nHTTP %{http_code} time_total:%{time_total}s time_starttransfer:%{time_starttransfer}s\\n'
```

Priya (serving): expected debug: `kernel=int8_attn(seq=512) -> fallback=attn_ref(seq=1024)` when alignment mismatch occurs. If you see that, it's the same issue.

Aisha (support): customers confirm timeouts stopped after we paused the rollout? some report improved latency after we paused.

Victor (runtime): mitigation options:
- temporarily disable dynamic int8 selector on canary (`rdw.qselect=int8_disabled`)
- reduce canary pool to 0% (pause rollout)
- quick rollback to v3.2.x (full rollback)
- try a config to force alternate packing algorithm (`rdw.int8_pack=alt`) — untested in prod

Jon (oncall): let's pause rollout and flip the selector off on canary. I will pause now.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout paused at 15% (manual pause by @Jon)

Victor (runtime): running command: `rctl runtime update --canary --set rdw.qselect=int8_disabled`

Victor (runtime): applied. monitoring metrics...

Harold (benchmarks): within 90s p95 on canary dropped from ~480ms -> ~220ms. p99 tail reduced significantly. p50 unchanged.

Aisha (support): updating customers: "we paused the rollout and applied a mitigation; please let us know if you still see issues." two customers ack'd improvements. :white_check_mark:

Priya (serving): notes for root cause: change landed as part of PR `f7c9a2` (dynamic int8 selector) and PR `b3e4f1` (packed-KV layout tweak). They landed back-to-back. need to bisect which commit triggers fallback alignment for long contexts.

Victor (runtime): plan for bisect:
1) reproduce locally with the provided curl against instrumented build to confirm failure.
2) `git bisect` between `v3.2.5` and `v3.3.0` focusing on commits affecting int8 selector and KV packing.
3) add a perf test that runs long-context generation (seq distribution mean ~900) and asserts p95 delta < 1.3x.

Jon (oncall): also add a canary gate: any kernel/quantization-selection change must run long-context perf check and block if p95 > baseline * 1.15.

Harold (benchmarks): I'll add the test to the perf harness and run a quick binary search on the CI images. if we reproduce, we'll pinpoint the exact diff.

Victor (runtime): follow ups: create incident ticket INC-2026, add note to release notes, and mark v3.3.0 as paused until fix. also add a runtime config flag to explicitly disable the new int8 packing by default for a hotfix.

Priya (serving): I'll prepare rollback playbook for customers who want immediate fix while we root-cause (manual rollback or runtime flag).

Jon (oncall): customers with short prompts unaffected — doc that in support KB so tickets can be triaged faster.

deploy-bot: Rollback executed: canary pool reverted to v3.2.5 at 07:48 by @Victor (runtime)

Victor (runtime): verified p95 back to baseline ~210ms across eu-central pools. I'll start the bisect after standup.

Aisha (support): marking customer tickets as updated; will reopen if they see regressions after we re-enable. thanks team. :pray:

Harold (benchmarks): action items: add long-context perf test, run `git bisect` on CI images, validate `rdw.qselect=int8_disabled` prevents fallback logs.

Victor (runtime): once bisect identifies the offending commit, we'll either back out that change or patch packing alignment. will post results here.

Jon (oncall): thanks everyone. key takeaways: smaller canary %, require perf tests for kernel/quantization changes, and runtime flags for quick mitigation.

Aisha (support): please ping when postmortem ready so I can close customer comms."
